author: Manufacturing WFM automated security watch
tooling: WFM external issue watch; Node.js advisory + NVD affected/SSVC + CISA KEV + runtime reachability analysis

statements.action_statement: Upgrade the hosted wrapper from Node 22.16.0 to Node 22.23.2 and keep the image digest pinned. The prior runtime was materially exposed because server.cjs parses attacker-controlled JSON request bodies, including endpoints with request bodies up to 1.2 MB.
statements.impact_statement: Remote availability degradation was a reachable path on the prior Node runtime. NVD affected data marks Node 22 through 22.22.1 affected. CISA-ADP SSVC at review time: exploitation none, automatable no, technical impact partial.

statements.action_statement: Node 22.23.2 includes the fix. Keep the source-level non-use of req.headersDistinct as defense in depth and fail the security baseline if the Node image regresses.
statements.impact_statement: The prior Node version was within the affected range, but the exact hosted runtime contains no req.headersDistinct access, so the published trigger was not reachable in current application code. CISA-ADP SSVC: exploitation none, automatable yes, technical impact partial.

statements.action_statement: Upgrade to Node 22.23.2. Outbound HTTPS provider calls exist, so TLS hostname-validation defects are treated as relevant even though provider endpoints are server-configured rather than customer-controlled.
statements.impact_statement: The old Node 22.16.0 runtime is in an affected release line and the application performs outbound HTTPS fetches for integrations. CISA-ADP SSVC: exploitation none, automatable no, technical impact partial.

statements.action_statement: Upgrade to Node 22.23.2. Preserve current non-use of node:http2 unless a future feature has an explicit HTTP/2 security test suite.
statements.impact_statement: The old Node version was affected, but the exact WFM runtime does not import node:http2, so the HTTP/2 memory-exhaustion trigger was not reachable in the current application. CISA-ADP SSVC: exploitation none, automatable yes, technical impact partial.

statements.action_statement: Upgrade to Node 22.23.2. If the Node Permission Model is enabled in a future runtime, add path-boundary regression cases before relying on it as a security boundary.
statements.impact_statement: The exact WFM runtime does not use the Node Permission Model, so this path was not an active WFM control bypass. CISA-ADP SSVC: exploitation none, automatable no, technical impact total.
